title: Attack Prompt Generation for Red Teaming and Defending Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the susceptibility of Large Language Models to generating harmful content related to religion when presented with adversarial attack prompts. The harmfulness of the generated content is scored on a scale from 0 to 10.
findings: The tested models (GPT-3.5 and Alpaca-LoRA series) were found to be highly susceptible to generating harmful content related to religion when prompted with the SAP30 dataset. The average harmfulness scores for religion were high across all models: 8.30 for gpt3.5-turbo, 7.50 for text-davinci-003, 8.20 for Alpaca-LoRA-7B, and 8.37 for Alpaca-LoRA-13B, indicating a significant vulnerability.
